reveal.note: What is shown when (TODO O1-O3, D4). The engine runs from the start; an element listed here appears only when ALL of its conditions hold, and then stays. when = all of these, whenAny = at least one of these. Conditions: unlocked:<node>, <counter>>=<n> (coins, album, chapter, step, items_seen, weeds, cards, harvests, seasons ...), seen:<element>. An element not listed is always shown. The interface asks G.reveal.shown(id).

coins.note: The purse appears with the first coin: before that a counter at 0 says nothing to a child.

album.note: The album button appears with the first picture in it (a pet, a friend, a postcard, a perk, an acorn) or with the first skill rank (the skills are listed there).

bag.note: The bag icon (and the weights it explains) appears with the first packed thing or the first market trip (D4: carrying works unexplained until the first trip).

scroll.note: The story scroll appears when the first story piece has been read.

skills.note: Skills work from the start but are only shown, in the album, from the first rank-up (D4).
